messages.subject: Re: qplot equivalent to plot(..., type='h')?
parts:

qplot(1:10, geom="histogram")

plot(1:10, type='h')

messages.subject: Re: qplot equivalent to plot(..., type='h')?
parts:
I'm not sure what you are actually after, but your example can be
reproduced with

qplot(1:10, ymin = 0, ymax = 1:10, geom="linerange")


Best,
Ista
